tools.name: metronome_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the Metronome account, with ids, names, ingest aliases and custom fields. Good first call to find a customer_id. Metronome API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: metronome_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by Metronome id: name, ingest aliases, customer_config, custom fields and current billable status. Metronome API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: metronome_list_contracts
tools.description: List a customer's contracts: rate card, commits, credits and start and end dates. Set include_archived for old contracts. Metronome API: POST /v1/contracts/list.

tools.name: metronome_get_contract
tools.description: Get one contract by id, with its initial terms, commits, credits, overrides and optional balance. Metronome API: POST /v2/contracts/get.

tools.name: metronome_list_customer_balances
tools.description: List a customer's commit and credit balances (prepaid funds, postpaid commitments, promotional credits). Metronome API: POST /v1/contracts/customerBalances/list.

tools.name: metronome_get_net_balance
tools.description: Get the combined current balance of a customer across commits and credits, optionally for one credit type. Metronome API: POST /v1/contracts/customerBalances/getNetBalance.

tools.name: metronome_list_invoices
tools.description: List a customer's invoices, newest first by default. Filter by type, date range or contract. Metronome API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/invoices.

tools.name: metronome_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its line items, applied credits, totals and billing period. Metronome API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: metronome_get_usage
tools.description: Get usage values per billable metric for one or more customers over a period, as hourly, daily or one total. Metronome API: POST /v1/usage.

tools.name: metronome_list_billable_metrics
tools.description: List billable metrics with their event filters, aggregation type and keys. Use the ids with metronome_get_usage. Metronome API: GET /v1/billable-metrics.

tools.name: metronome_list_customer_alerts
tools.description: List the alerts (threshold notifications) on one customer and whether each is triggered. Metronome API: POST /v1/customer-alerts/list.

tools.name: metronome_list_products
tools.description: List the products in the pricing catalog (contract pricing products), with their billable metric and names. Metronome API: POST /v1/contract-pricing/products/list.

tools.name: metronome_list_credit_types
tools.description: List the credit types (currencies and custom credit units) in the account. Use the ids with metronome_get_net_balance. Metronome API: GET /v1/credit-types/list.

tools.name: metronome_ingest_events
tools.description: Send 1 to 100 usage events to Metronome. Each event needs a unique transaction_id (a retry with the same id is not counted twice) and bills the customer. Only send events you mean to bill. Metronome API: POST /v1/ingest.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: metronome_list_contracts, metronome_get_contract, metronome_list_customer_balances, metronome_get_net_balance, metronome_get_usage, metronome_list_customer_alerts, metronome_list_products · Public sink: metronome_list_contracts, metronome_get_contract, metronome_list_customer_balances, metronome_get_net_balance, metronome_get_usage, metronome_list_customer_alerts, metronome_list_products, metronome_ingest_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: metronome_list_contracts, metronome_get_contract, metronome_list_customer_balances, metronome_get_net_balance, metronome_get_usage, metronome_list_customer_alerts, metronome_list_products · Public sink: metronome_list_contracts, metronome_get_contract, metronome_list_customer_balances, metronome_get_net_balance, metronome_get_usage, metronome_list_customer_alerts, metronome_list_products, metronome_ingest_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
